Author: ruminabottle
Name: Dungeon Master XIV
Punchline: Dice, initiative and encounter tracking for in-game tabletop sessions.
Description:
Dice, initiative and encounter tracking for tabletop roleplay sessions run inside FFXIV.

This does nothing on its own. Everyone playing needs this plugin installed, and it needs a connection to a relay — one person hosts a session and admits the others individually with a code. There is nothing to try alone, and anyone without the plugin cannot take part.

Rolls are made in the plugin rather than by the game, so 4d6+2 works where /dice cannot. Campaign history is stored on the host's machine.
